run_cluster_mean_shift: run MeanShift clustering on sample blob data with automatically estimated bandwidth
build_estimate_bandwidth: build an estimated bandwidth value from sample data using quantile-based bandwidth estimation
create_make_blobs_dataset: create synthetic blob dataset with specified centers and cluster standard deviation
run_plot_clustering: run plotting of clustering results with colored markers per cluster and cluster centers
run_unique_cluster_labels: run extraction of unique cluster labels and count estimated number of clusters
